goal_a_reason: Free-text replies require semantic similarity scoring to tolerate paraphrasing (e.g. 'Hi Alice!' vs 'Hello, Alice!') without inspecting tool calls.
goal_b_reason: Deterministic tree-based comparison handles JSON key-ordering and minor whitespace differences without any LLM.
goal_c_reason: Binary pass/fail on whether the literal substring 'deployment succeeded' appears anywhere in the output is exactly what the contains evaluator does.
